title: Pocket2D rendering.config
description: Window and clear-color settings validated by ValidateRenderingConfig in src/shared/config/GameConfig.cpp. The file is optional and must be a JSON object without duplicate member names. Every field is optional; unknown fields are ignored by the loader and therefore allowed here. Integers must be exact 32-bit JSON integers (rapidjson IsInt).

zoom_factor.description: Camera zoom: a finite positive number no larger than the largest 32-bit float.
